title: Design Partner Target List (Reference Program / Case Studies)
content:
Last updated: 2025-06-20 (Tyler)

Purpose
- Working tracker for the structured case study + customer reference program.
- Goal: recruit 3–5 design partners for (1) public case study + (2) scheduled reference calls.
- This sheet is the “single source of truth” for target status + next steps.

Sheet: Filters / quick views (manual notes)
- “Top 3 for public by probability”: Arcadia Health, QuantaPay, NovaDocs
- “Fastest to publish (low legal drag)”: VectorForge, NovaDocs
- “Reference-only near-term”: HelioSupport (once stabilized), GlassKite AI (if logo ok)

Scoring rubric (internal)
- ICP Fit (1–5): match to core deployment modes + strong measurable outcomes + credible brand in target vertical.
- Champion Strength (1–5): seniority + responsiveness + willingness to go on-record + influence over approvals.
- Reference Readiness (1–5): stable production usage, no open P0 support issues, metrics are reproducible, clear boundaries for what can be shared.

Operational notes
- Please keep statuses consistent with the pipeline: add the “blocker” in Notes when a status hasn’t moved in >10 business days.
- If Legal In Review: link the release form thread + list approvers (customer side) in Notes.
- Metrics Validated requires: measurement window, baseline definition, data sources (Console dashboards / customer telemetry), and owner sign-off (SE + CS).

Open questions (as of 2025-06-20)
- Do we allow “public case study” without logo (anonymized) as a first-class option on the site? Camila/Soojin to confirm.
- For QuantaPay: do we publish absolute p95 numbers or only % improvement + workload shape caveat? Pending Soojin + Naomi review.
- For Arcadia: what level of network diagram detail is allowed (VPC boundary only vs components)? Pending customer security review.
